policy: Read-only reachability record. A page listed here is NOT a price. Only a two-sided, first-party prematch series line or a published official rating may produce a number, and the ladder in scripts/originate.py decides which one is used.

sources.name: HLTV match listing
sources.note: Cloudflare challenge to the runner. HLTV identity pages were readable from a normal reader on 2026-10-22 (ranking and match pages verified by hand), so HLTV guides identity and ranking but cannot supply an automated prematch price.

sources.name: HLTV known match page
sources.note: Same 403 challenge. Readable by hand; not an odds source at all (HLTV publishes a fan vote and analytics, not a two-sided prematch line).

sources.name: HLTV world ranking
sources.note: Ranking page also 403 to the runner, yet the collector still obtains the dated ranking through a saved official page; the ranking rung is unaffected.

sources.name: EGamersWorld CS2 matches

sources.name: EGamersWorld known match
sources.note: Cloudflare 403 to the runner (the 2026-10-21 reading was made by hand).

conclusion: Of the sources reachable from the runner, only Polymarket, Kalshi (API), Thunderpick, Bovada, bo3.gg and OddsPortal/DraftKings landing pages answered; HLTV, EGamersWorld, GG.BET, BetBoom, 1xBet and Marathonbet block unattended access. No new independent two-sided price source was found that closes a fixture the existing ladder leaves open.
